verdict.rationale: Circle documents some native autonomous behavior. Agent Wallets let an AI agent hold funds and transact onchain autonomously within spending policies the user defines. CCTP can also trigger automated actions on the destination chain after assets arrive. However, both are narrow, payment-specific mechanisms rather than a general way to set up background automations, and the agent logic itself must be built by the user. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring background jobs, monitoring and management of running automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
